strategy.offer: Develops, manufactures and sells machinery, systems and after-sales services for conveying, filtering and pumping process media, plus assembly and transport automation solutions.
strategy.customers: Serves manufacturers across industries, especially metalworking users and factories needing material flow, coolant management, production support and intralogistics automation.
strategy.why_we_win: Expects to win through customer value, profitability and sustainability, modular tailored systems, reliable quality, responsive global service, and continual innovation.
strategy.resources: Built on engineering, design, production, quality management, service and IT capabilities, a skilled workforce, binding company principles, certifications, and an international sales and service network.
strategy.direction: Aims to keep growing by expanding offerings and delivering smarter, more automated, digital and sustainable solutions for tomorrow's efficient production.
